name: AgentScout
description: AgentScout is a read-only directory of 1,786 AI agent tools, including 249 MCP servers, with link checks and pricing as makers state it. It has no chat or task endpoint; read the static JSON feeds below or use the read-only MCP server (https://agentscout-mcp.agentscouthq.workers.dev/mcp).
interaction: static, read-only files over HTTPS GET, plus a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP); no authentication; no A2A task endpoint
